title: Add unit/integration test coverage

title: Remove grid from page margins
description: Canvas spec allocates 48px padding on all sides (usable grid 720x960 inside 816x1056), but the page grid background currently fills the full page so the margin area also shows the grid. Remove grid lines from the margin so margins remain blank in preview/PDF while keeping snap boundaries aligned to the usable area.

title: Stabilize widget code badges
